notes.title: Climate Changes
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Temperature[/b][/h2]

1.Biomes will be characterized by varying temperatures that may result in discomfort or potential harm to the body and feet. Wearing appropriate clothing and footwear can provide insulation and protection, as well as maintain durability despite wear and tear.

2.When you are indoors in a room with surrounding walls, you are shielded from potential harm caused by the environment. The presence of heat or cold sources inside the room will impact the temperature within. A comparison of the environmental heat levels before and after a fire is introduced is shown below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/4d41420cdd37a1bedf7f6328d28455a580e1a1b1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/d34846621e8090f5575d54eee548a1a252943c1f.png[/img]

3.Standing directly beside to a fire or any heat source will have a greater effect on you, both indoors and outdoors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/62099e4b75755c6471d9a9e92f49a127877567f9.png[/img]

4.Drinking water will temporarily lower your body temperature. Making it beneficial to bring water with you when visiting warmer biomes such as deserts or jungles. Furthermore, certain foods can also causing temporary increases or decreases of body temperature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/2488bf5518c3b39fcf2bb46fa33a65320186ea35.png[/img]

5.When your body temperature is negative, your metabolic rate will increase in order to sustain basic bodily functions. Therefore you will start to use more food per minute just to stay alive. If the impact becomes significant enough to cause concern, a debuff icon will be displayed. The number on the icon indicates your current rate of food consumption per minute (67 per minute in this instance).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/b26fe581eeb3866d1a72a32630e80ef8d43f3ae2.png[/img]

6.When your body temperature is too high, a separate debuff will be activated causing your stamina to deplete at a quicker rate during work or physical activity. This debuff indicates the percentage increase in stamina cost for you.

To alleviate this issue, it is recommended to hydrate with water or seek a cooler environment such as a room with a fan to lower your body temperature and improve efficiency.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/81b89787e3797b1dc257d2a134c533bdd0d0a754.png[/img]

[h2][b]Rooms[/b][/h2]

The maximum dimensions for a room will be 16 tiles wide and 16 tiles tall. Anything larger will be classified as an outdoor area.

We are able to measure the size of each room and identify any permanent fixtures present, such as a fire pit, furnace, or oven. By analyzing the size and equipment within a room, we can determine its intended purpose and provide special benefits when you occupy that space.

In this update, we will only be implementing a limited portion of this feature, granting a stamina recovery boost to all rooms above a certain size.

Future updates will further enhance this feature, with benefits such as increased blacksmithing proficiency in a Smithy, improved stamina recovery in a Bedroom, and enhanced cooking abilities in a Kitchen, among others.

[h2][b]Mannequins[/b][/h2]

In order to streamline the process of dressing and changing attire, a new Mannequin object will be introduced. This object allows for a set of clothes and shoes to be placed on it, with a single command facilitating the switch between the current attire and the items on the mannequin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/61aa626254dc76b050d67cc8d3d954cf177333ee.png[/img]

[h2][b]Hopper-Powered Fan[/b][/h2]

If a hopper is placed in this device and properly fed, it will generate cool air. This functionality is most effective when used within an enclosed structure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/86157f82c7ff9bfcaa22b4abf039249b1ccbca95.png[/img]

[h2][b]Straw Clothing[/b][/h2]

A new type of clothing that can be made without the need for specific tools such as an awl or rope.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/114c2342330d9ebf63534e4c1de65a0170949f33.png[/img]

notes.title: Transportation Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/7e8ec6e3e429ff3c658fc3727d791252426a42ba.png[/img]

[h2][b]Pushcart[/b][/h2]
Invented during Bronze Age 1.
This carry more weight than a sled and will cost less stamina to run with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/351f337f5e8f7edfbfba32d6990a28c2c0877d12.png[/img]

[h2][b]Pull Cart [/b][/h2]
Invented during Iron Age 1.
Heavier than pushcart, but more efficient for heavy items, and can take 6 items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/858210c7c19951c2cf6b7daa78417dadf0e4283d.png[/img]

[h2][b]Kirisaur[/b][/h2]

During Iron Age 3, you can find strange egg that has lied buried in the desert sands for millennia. Once hatched you will have a loyal riding pet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/15479a99f125cec8f624da745afba10399607b23.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/c8c089d206473d1555f9e18ba3ab852170a8639f.png[/img]

You can ride the Kirisaur once it reaches adulthood and has a saddle.

The passenger can hunt from the kirisaur back, and will have higher range compared to when standing on the ground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/69298f7806198c605a4a9e2490b589f3c1f33fea.png[/img]

You can also use a Kirisaur as a pack animal, instead of riding it. It can then carry up to 20 items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/162ecb9131e0109edc3c4cfc3c5548564e1c749c.png[/img]

Feed your Kirisaur spikefruits to keep it happy (and alive!). It will follow the person who fed it last, but only until it grows hungry again.
If you put blinders on a Kirisaur, it will believe that it is night and fall asleep. Once asleep it won't move around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/4fbfb613450712a10f725caf30fa79610c41dbd0.png[/img]

You can also get Tomahawk Steaks from dead Kirisaurs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/0a8d94ac5602f7c1aad55b104470cfc7fa951c7e.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Mechanism:[/b][/h2]
Running will consume more stamina when you carry heavy items, and less when you do not (both compared to previous release). Use backpacks, sleds and carts to make the stamina use less.
Walking is still not costing any stamina, even if you carry heavy items.


[h2][b]Other Updates [/b][/h2]

Kirisaur Mask

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/4755cbf3d083fd233bb55241bd4fbffc642fd8e9.png[/img]

New container: Bucket

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/f0222af3a6f5aafb32ff516b0a484e6d2b422e5a.png[/img]

Evo Oil: can be used to revitalize Kirisaur egg. Also now evo oil is required for Spiked Milk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/0114a2e646878ca1f8fb1dda8bf7ae56470173b8.png[/img]

You can now grow moringa trees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/c684ecdb3b3e2e55300927a1843a69da67149e96.png[/img]

[h2][b]Bug Fix[/b][/h2]
removed/improved some jumping of characters and/or animals that could happen occasionally.

Many players requested this, so we have now added it in game!
New items you can stack in this update:
-Leaf Bowls

notes.title: Game Update: Breaking the Mold
notes.notes:
What's new:

User experience improvements:
- Use mouse scroll wheel to zoom in and out smoothly (the near/medium/far setting is removed)
- New visual effect for highlighting the selected object. A white outline instead of stripes across the object.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/39ffb0a5be81ea82f913a66f7890a62c951bde39.png[/img]

- You will be notified every time you increase any skill level
- You will now see the "fail frustration" speech bubbles of other players too, making it easier to see if they are working on something or just standing there.
- Picking up more objects when your hands are already full works differently now: instead of dropping the item in your front hand, you now drop the item in your back hand, and the item that was in the front hand is moved to the back hand.
- Eating soup and stew now also shows the eating animation and plays the eating sound.

Content changes:
- New and improved process for creating and using the clay molds for bronze casting. Some steps were removed, and some steps and new objects were added, to improve the experience and make mold making more interesting.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/5e6eff47e1a6512e7fbb12307a28844202509be5.png[/img]

- Removed a step in the creation of flint shards and flint blades. Now they are produced directly from flint nodules without the intermediate step of half nodules.
- Changed so leaf bowls are made from a single leaf instead of two, and also so you cut one leaf at a time from the ferns. New players had too many difficulties before they got it right, so we hope this change will make it easier for them to get further into the game.
- added option to remove a dirt floor.

Fixed bugs:
- Fixed visual bug for a full clay pot with fruit salad or other food.
- Fixed bug that a shovel could dig infinite numbers of stone paths

notes.title: Tribe System Update
notes.notes:
In this update we made some big game changing changes. Instead of the play being island based it is now tribe based. You start a new tribe and try to not die out while reaching the technology goals together. If your tribe dies out you can still resurrect it as long as there are any resurrection points left.

[b]Beginner tribes[/b] work similarly like islands did before: they are not connected to any individual players and once one is started it stays online until it has been finished (meaning end of stone age in this case), no matter how long it takes. New beginner tribes will start automatically, so there will always be one to play on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/e5a65af9ae702c12202e6d7d3f8393e969a406c8.png[/img]

[b]Standard tribes[/b] will be started and named by you players. They will go online when players are active on them, and will go offline when no-one is playing on them. When a player activates a tribe it will become visible for other players to join also. The tribes can be resurrected from offline (dead) status several times, but not infinitely. Each player can only resurrect a limited number of tribes.

You will have three slots for your favorite tribes. It can be both tribes you have started yourself and tribes that you have joined after someone else started them. Creating or adopting a tribe as yours, grants you the power to resurrect it from offline (dead) state.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/81c7750d64326386b4f64160dbe6ea6609bbabff.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/0ae89c02d361ed5eeac0d3ada9a7cd3815733b7c.png[/img]


Skills will be mapped differently on different difficulty levels, and experience gain will be slower on lower difficulty and faster on higher difficulty.

Hunger rate, animal behaviors, and wound seriousness will also change with the difficulty levels. On higher difficulty you won't be able to stand around inactively for as long before you start starving, animals get stronger and less afraid of fire, etc...

In this update we also added wooden chests and tables :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/f379167cb4db8d98d12d159261142a52c2d26fda.png[/img]

And you can mine copper and tin lodes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/f10a592805dcba1db2f9808edfa6c4dd26987b44.png[/img]

notes.title: Game Update: farming, pottery, and better instructions
notes.notes:
Hi players,

Time for a content and ease-of-use update!


[b]Farming[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/25afbfe631c2bf59fbd1904a7bebcda88d4b6aa8.gif[/img]
Take survival to the next level by starting to grow your own foods and materials.
Stone age level farming means digging a hole, inserting seeds or pieces of tubers, cover with soil and adding water. Then you wait...


[b]Pottery[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/3be01656fdde65551f506520a860597cafb1c650.png[/img]
You can now find clay in the jungle. Use it to shape pottery, which you fire in the new fire pit to make it solid.

We added a new recipe for soup: gather all ingredients on a work mat, grab a knife and water and mix it all together in the new clay bowl. Then heat it by the fire and share it with your tribe.


[b]Improved Crafting Info[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/4b0960de518a1fcafedb5d6cf3e9e49167273081.png[/img]
The ICB (Item and Crafting Browser) has been overhauled to present the crafting steps in a clearer way, with the most important details showing first.

The steps are inverted, so you always see the final steps without scrolling, and steps for making some of the sub-ingredients have been hidden, to improve quick understanding (just click on any item to see the steps for creating it though).


[b]Improved Item Selection[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/3fafa8181014c8c83ce8acd6cfc01f9ba1e4562c.png[/img]
You can now choose exactly which item you want to pick out from a container.


[b]Smaller changes:[/b]
- Nerfed deadly animals, so they are easier to escape from
- Dead Howlers and Death-Claws now disappear after 1h
- You can now remove wall frames
- Nerfed banana trees (now 15 minutes to respawn)
- Cutting a fern into leaves is now a harvest action
- Removing/putting on clothes are now on different buttons and don't conflict with eating
- Fish spawn back more frequently
- Un-censored several words that users wanted to be able to say
- Fixed several visual bugs
- Fixed that Grass Rope was sometimes called by the wrong name in the ICB
- Plus other bug fixes and improvements...

notes.title: Game Update: Animal Attacks!
notes.notes:
Hi players!

If you have read through the information under "Early Access" you know that the development is currently focusing on bringing more challenges to the game play. The first instalment is this update with wild animals that can chase you, harm you, and potentially kill you.
Bandages for your wounds will follow in a later update, so survival will get tricky in our world for a while. Don't worry though - as long as your tribe builds enough Cairns to show the way, you can always respawn and find your way back to what you were doing before those pesky animals killed you ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/feba6531351bcf6f9896470f64ccafed433ad6bc.gif[/img]
The Howlers are hunting in packs of 3-4 animals. They chase both Hoppers, Zezelles, and humans. They will prefer slower individuals, like children or elderly players, so the tribe must try and keep these vulnerable people safe!
Killing one of the pack will make the others abandon the fight. If you don't have a spear, then RUN! If you run far enough, they will lose interest. Running though jungle is also a good way to confuse them.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/fc98273b00dca606a33a0f049c75d597c9daa39c.gif[/img]
The Death-Claw is usually alone. If you go too close to it, it will start stalking you and will eventually charge. The best you can do when it charges is to run. It will chase you for a while, but will eventually get exhausted. At that point you can escape, but if your goal is to kill the Death-Claw, then your only chance is to succeed with a spear thrust while it is exhausted. If you fail, it will immediately attack you again.
We do not recommend anyone taking on a Death-Claw on their own. If you collaborate, then one player can act as a lure, while the other player conserves their stamina and then attack when the Death-Claw is exhausted. Death-Claws will hunt and eat Zezelles, so they can be used to distract it.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375575/390045e226282a010fd965f1479ae7dba8d2cfec.gif[/img]
The Chickarex is [i]not[/i] your pet! If you go too close to its nest while it is close, it will attack.
On the other hand, chickarexes will also attack Howlers and Death-Claws, and can be used to distract them.

You can get wounded multiple times. Each wound will deal some direct damage and some damage over time. A light wound shows as scratches on your arm, while a medium one shows as claw marks on your thigh. If you get a large wound on your chest and abdomen, then it will be a mortal one. Use the time you have left to say farewell to your fellow tribe members ːsteamsadː
You can't generate health while you are still wounded, but as soon as the wounds are healed, you will begin to generate health again (as long as you have eaten enough food)

Finally, fire is a good way to keep dangerous animals away. Consider having several fires going at your camp at all times.
